text: Second, quickly, the nucleophile attacks. Because the carbocation is flat, it can attack from either face with equal ease, so a single enantiomer gives a fifty fifty mixture of both products: racemisation. And since hydroxide only arrives after the slow step, it does not appear in the rate law at all. Rate equals k times the haloalkane concentration only.
